title: Verify sticky header navigation and smooth scroll
description: Ensure the header remains sticky during scrolling, navigation links scroll smoothly to respective sections, and active section highlights update correctly.

steps.description: Load the homepage.
Scroll down the page slowly.
Verify the header remains fixed at the top of the viewport.
Click each navigation link in the header.
Confirm the page scrolls smoothly to the correct section for each link.
Check that the navigation link corresponding to the currently viewed section is highlighted as active.

title: Test mobile hamburger menu functionality
description: Verify hamburger menu appears on small screens, opens and closes correctly, and navigation links within the menu work as expected.

steps.description: Resize the browser viewport to a mobile screen width.
Check that the hamburger menu icon is visible on the header.
Click the hamburger menu icon to open the mobile menu.
Verify the navigation menu slides in or becomes visible.
Click each navigation link inside the mobile menu.
Confirm the page scrolls smoothly to the relevant section and the menu closes after navigation.
Click outside the menu or the close icon.
Verify the mobile menu closes.

title: Dark/light theme toggle with persistent storage
description: Validate the theme toggle changes the UI theme, persists user preference across page reloads and sessions, and transitions smoothly.

steps.description: Load the homepage with default theme.
Click the theme toggle button in the header.
Ensure the website theme switches between dark and light modes without jank.
Reload the page.
Confirm the previously selected theme is applied on page load.
Close the browser tab and reopen the website.
Verify the theme preference persists across sessions.

title: Hero section animations and call-to-action buttons
description: Verify that hero text reveals, floating background elements animate properly, call-to-action buttons function, and scroll indicator is visible.

steps.description: Load the homepage.
Check hero text reveals smoothly on page load.
Observe floating background elements animate continuously without lag.
Verify the scroll indicator is visible and animates.
Click on each call-to-action button (e.g., Contact, Projects).
Confirm the page scrolls to respective sections smoothly.

title: About section profile avatar animation and content display
description: Ensure the profile avatar animates on load, personal introduction and quick facts are displayed correctly.

steps.description: Navigate or scroll to the About section.
Verify the profile avatar performs its animation on section reveal.
Check that the personal introduction text is visible and correctly formatted.
Ensure quick facts appear with intended animation effects.

title: Skills section interactive badges and hover effects
description: Check that skills are categorized into frontend, AI/ML, backend, and interactive hover effects respond correctly for each skill badge.

steps.description: Navigate or scroll to the Skills section.
Verify that the frontend, AI/ML, and backend skill categories are clearly displayed.
Hover over each skill badge.
Confirm that the hover effect triggers (e.g., tooltip, highlight) for each badge.
Check that no overlapping or layout break occurs on hover.

title: Gallery section category filters and lightbox modal
description: Validate that gallery images filter correctly by category, hover effects display, lightbox modal opens with project previews, and animations remain smooth.

steps.description: Navigate or scroll to the Gallery section.
Click on each category filter button.
Verify only images belonging to the selected category are displayed.
Hover over gallery images.
Check that hover effects (e.g., zoom, shadow) apply smoothly.
Click a gallery image to open the lightbox modal.
Verify the lightbox modal displays the image with detailed view and navigation controls.
Navigate between images inside the lightbox.
Confirm transitions are smooth and images update correctly.
Close the lightbox modal.
Check that the modal closes and returns focus to the gallery section.

title: Projects section featured project cards and links
description: Verify featured projects display detailed information, technology tags, status badges, and functional GitHub/demo links.

steps.description: Navigate or scroll to the Projects section.
Confirm presence of four featured project cards.
Check each project card displays project details and technology tags correctly.
Verify status badges (e.g., Live, Complete) are present and accurate.
Click GitHub and demo links on each project card.
Confirm each link opens the correct external page without errors.

title: Contact form validation and submission
description: Test the contact form fields validate correctly, show error messages for invalid inputs, and submit successfully with valid inputs.

steps.description: Navigate or scroll to the Contact section.
Try to submit the form with all fields empty.
Check that validation errors prompt for required fields.
Enter invalid data in each field (e.g., invalid email format).
Verify corresponding error messages appear.
Fill all form fields with valid data.
Submit the form.
Confirm form submits successfully without errors and user receives confirmation feedback.

title: Contact section social links and resume download
description: Verify social media links and email info are displayed and clickable, and the resume download link functions correctly.

steps.description: Navigate or scroll to the Contact section.
Check social media links (e.g., LinkedIn, Twitter) are visible.
Click each social media link.
Confirm the links open the correct external social media pages.
Verify email address is visible and formatted correctly.
Click the resume download link or button.
Ensure the resume downloads successfully and is the expected file.

title: Accessibility compliance for keyboard navigation and ARIA labels
description: Test keyboard-only navigation across all interactive elements, verify ARIA labels exist where appropriate, and screen reader announces elements correctly.

steps.description: Use keyboard tab/shift-tab to navigate through the entire website.
Check that focus is visible and moves in a logical order through all interactive elements (navigation, buttons, links, form inputs).
Use a screen reader to navigate the website.
Verify that ARIA labels and roles correctly describe elements such as navigation, sections, buttons, and form fields.
Ensure no interactive element is inaccessible via keyboard or missing ARIA support.

title: Performance metrics verification
description: Measure and validate the website meets performance targets: Lighthouse score 90+, FCP under 1.5s, TTI under 3.5s, and CLS below 0.1.

steps.description: Run Lighthouse or equivalent performance audit on the homepage and major sections.
Ensure the overall Lighthouse performance score is 90 or higher.
Check First Contentful Paint (FCP) is under 1.5 seconds.
Confirm Time to Interactive (TTI) is under 3.5 seconds.
Verify Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) is below 0.1.

title: Cross-browser and cross-device rendering
description: Verify that the website renders correctly and functions properly across supported desktop browsers and mobile devices.

steps.description: Open the website on major browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge.
Check that layout, navigation, animations, and UI components render properly and consistently.
Access the website on various mobile devices and screen sizes.
Confirm responsiveness, menu toggling, touch interactions, and animations function as intended.

title: SEO elements verification
description: Check that key SEO best practices are implemented including metadata, headings, alt texts, and crawlable links.

steps.description: Inspect the page source and metadata.
Verify presence of meta title and description tags with relevant content about Charan Katkam portfolio.
Check proper usage of H1, H2 headings corresponding to section titles.
Confirm all images have meaningful alt text attributes.
Ensure internal navigation links are crawlable and semantic HTML tags are used.

title: UI animations and transitions smoothness
description: Validate that all animations and UI transitions run smoothly without jitter or freezes throughout user interactions.

steps.description: Observe animations on page load (hero text reveal, avatar animation, quick facts, badges, gallery and project transitions).
Verify that all animations play smoothly at consistent frame rates without stuttering.
Interact with UI elements triggering animations (hover effects, lightbox opens/closes, theme toggle transitions).
Confirm transitions occur without visible delays, flickers, or jankiness.
